findings.summary: A plan re-review that expands --tasks still sends only the document delta (empty when unchanged), so newly included tasks can receive passing review evidence without the reviewer seeing their text; force full input when the plan-review scope changes.

A conformance re-review can change --plan or --tasks yet receive only an empty or incremental delta, allowing evidence for newly declared promises without reviewing their implementation; force full review when the checked plan or task scope changes.
